column1: # The GC stress lane's pinned rows (#626), which scripts/run_larceny_gc_stress.sh
# holds each suite's run under PATINA_GC_STRESS to; its header has the
# intervals and what fails the lane.
# passed, total, min_collections. status, passed and total are
# scripts/larceny_report.py's classification of the suite's log, and are a
# plain release run's: collection must not change what a suite computes.
# `-` for status and passed holds only the total, and that the suite reached
# a tally: `time`, whose passed count measures the machine's clock and speed.
# min_collections is half the collections the row's run made, a count that
# is deterministic for a suite at a given interval, and at least 1.
# A change that moves a suite's tally moves its rows here in the same pull
# request, on every lane it moves; scripts/run_larceny_tests.sh warns when a
# Measured against larcenists/larceny at fef550c7d392, on macOS arm64
# (2026-10-02), and checked on the nightly's ubuntu x86_64 runner
# (2026-10-03, #633's first run). The rows are the runner's: on x86_64,
# flonum fails one more assertion than on arm64 (flonum.sld:693, #634), with
# or without stress, so on macOS arm64 the lane reports flonum as "not the
# collector". Every other row and every collection count held on both.
